question: Should this issue remain the broad memory-management consistency tracker while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 and companion memory MVP issues handle narrower slices, or should maintainers narrow it to one specific memory config/API contract?
rationale: The remaining work changes public memory config, plugin ownership, doctor migration, docs, and memory lifecycle semantics, which requires maintainer product/API direction rather than a small bug-fix lane.

options.title: Keep As Broad Tracker
options.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until role slots, backend selection, flush behavior, and operator memory surfaces converge.

options.title: Narrow To Role Slots
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/60572 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/88504 as the canonical role-slot path and keep this issue only for non-role-slot leftovers.

options.title: Define Unified Memory Type
options.body: Sponsor a smaller `memory.type` style config design, accepting that it may not solve plugin role ownership or memory-write lifecycle by itself.

recommendation.title: Keep As Broad Tracker
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the umbrella until role slots, backend selection, flush behavior, and operator memory surfaces converge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory docs and memory-core history make this the best visible routing candidate for deciding the public memory contract.
